name: homepage-frontend
description: Frontend build tools for personal homepage

scripts.build:fontawesome: cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css static/fontawesome.css && sed -i.bak 's|../webfonts/|./webfonts/|g' static/fontawesome.css && rm -f static/fontawesome.css.bak && cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts static/ && cp static/fontawesome.css backend/public/static/fontawesome.css && cp -r static/webfonts backend/public/static/
scripts.build: npm run build:fontawesome && npm run build:css
